verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own public API for programmatically adding candidates, fetching jobs and automating recruitment processes, plus a machine-readable spec and an HTTP MCP server, so it can be driven without the UI. However, there is no first-party CLI, CI integration guide, or documented headless or pipeline workflow; the probe 404s apply only to the docs-domain OpenAPI paths, while the spec is published at app.dover.com, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI/pipeline integration docs, documented headless auth/automation patterns (e.g., service accounts in CI), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: With the API, you can programmatically add candidates to your jobs, fetch job listings, and automate various recruitment processes.
Use it to generate a client or to give an AI coding tool the exact endpoints and fields.
You can add Dover as an HTTP MCP server directly from your terminal.
